newsitem.title: USA: OPIC backs U.S. projects in Russia worth $335 mln.
newsitem.headline: OPIC backs U.S. projects in Russia worth $335 mln.

text.p: The U.S. Overseas Private Investment Corp (OPIC) signed agreements on Friday worth more than $335million for U.S. projects in Russia.

One business protocol was signed with Sakhalin Energy Investment Co Ltd. for a $116 million in project financing for oil development in the Russian far east. Sakhalin is 30 percent owned by the Houston-based Marathon Oil Co and 20 percent by New Orleans-based McDermott International Inc, OPIC said in a statement.

The others included the Russian Federation State Committee for the Support and Development of Small Business Investment in Russia; insurance contracts worth more than $70 million for two defense conversion projects; and a $150 million agreement to expand OPIC's support of U.S. financial service projects operating in Russia.

OPIC made the announcements during the eighth meeting of the U.S.-Russian Joint Commission on Economic and Technological Cooperation, led by Vice President Al Gore and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
